q: When light passes from a medium to a more optically dense medium, both reflection and refraction will occur for _____ angles of incidence.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. When light passes from a medium to a more optically dense medium, both reflection and refraction will occur for all angles of incidence. Some or no is not this quantity.

q: At a certain angle of incidence, the angle of refraction becomes $90^{\circ}$. This angle of incidence is called the _____ angle.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. At a certain angle of incidence, the angle of refraction becomes 90°. This angle of incidence is called the critical angle.

q: When the angle of incidence is greater than the critical angle, light does not enter the less dense medium but is reflected back. This is called total _____ reflection.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. When the angle of incidence is greater than the critical angle, light does not enter the less dense medium but is reflected back. This is called total internal reflection.

q: If medium x is air, the relation between critical angle $i_c$ and refractive index $n$ of medium y is $\sin i_c = $ _____.
e: If medium x is air, the relation between critical angle i_c and refractive index n of medium y is sin i_c = 1/n. n or 1/n² is a different relation from 1/n.

q: A prism is a transparent object usually made of glass, and it has two plane surfaces inclined to each other. The angle $A$ is known as the angle of _____.
e: A prism is a transparent object usually made of glass, and it has two plane surfaces inclined to each other. The angle A is known as the angle of prism. Do not trade prism for deviation or incidence.

q: The angle $D$ between the direction of incident ray and that of emergent ray is known as the angle of _____.
e: The angle D between the direction of incident ray and that of emergent ray is known as the angle of deviation. Do not trade deviation for prism or incidence.

q: When the angle of incidence is varied, the angle of deviation $D$ decreases gradually to a _____ value and then increases.
e: When the angle of incidence is varied, the angle of deviation D decreases gradually to a minimum value and then increases. Maximum or zero is not this quantity.

q: It is found that the angle of incidence is equal to the angle of emergence when the angle of deviation is _____.
e: It is found that the angle of incidence is equal to the angle of emergence when the angle of deviation is minimum. Maximum or zero is not this quantity.

q: In the minimum deviation case, the angle of the prism $A$ is equal to _____.
e: In the minimum deviation case, the angle of the prism A is equal to 2r_1. Do not trade 2r_1 for r_1 or r_1 + r_2.

q: The formula for the refractive index of a prism material at minimum deviation is $n = $ _____.
e: The formula for the refractive index of a prism material at minimum deviation is n = (sin((A+D_m)/(2)))/(sin((A)/(2))). (sin((A-D_m)/(2)))/(sin((A)/(2))) or (sin((A)/(2)))/(sin((A+D_m)/(2))) is a different relation from (sin((A+D_m)/(2)))/(sin((A)/(2))).

q: A prism having angles $90^{\circ}-45^{\circ}-45^{\circ}$ can be used as a total _____ prism.
e: A prism having angles 90°-45°-45° can be used as a total reflecting prism. Do not trade reflecting for dispersing or refracting.

q: In a total reflecting prism, _____ percent of the light is reflected.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. In a total reflecting prism, 100 percent of the light is reflected. Do not trade 100 for 50 or 75.

q: Total reflecting prisms are used in periscopes and _____.
e: Total reflecting prisms are used in periscopes and binoculars. Do not trade binoculars for telescopes or microscopes.

q: A transparent rod in which successive total internal reflections occur is called a light _____.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. A transparent rod in which successive total internal reflections occur is called a light pipe. Do not trade pipe for tube or beam.

q: Splitting of white light into different colour-bands is called _____ of light.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. Splitting of white light into different colour-bands is called scattering of light. Dispersion or diffraction is not this quantity.

q: When white light passes through a prism, the _____ colour is deviated the most.
e: Lenses refract. Light is an electromagnetic wave and also a particle. When white light passes through a prism, the violet colour is deviated the most. Do not trade violet for red or green.

q: The refractive index of the prism material for _____ colour has the smallest value.
e: The refractive index of the prism material for red colour has the smallest value. Violet or blue is not this quantity.
